proposed_move: Use one scope-separated limitation table in the round synthesis: revision, subject, evidence class and unresolved limitation. Do not collapse reader recommendations, row statuses and counter outputs into verified.

expected_effect.benefit: Improve calibration of documentary claims without changing monitored bytes, criteria, runtime or measured coverage.

interactions.limitation: Three executed gate rows and accurate documented exits do not establish C2 exact-element contract satisfaction.
interactions.contradiction: The critic retains C2_R57_PASS=true despite empty element-equal-to-CODES lists on refusal rows; current source token extraction is weaker than the canonical equality clause. This is not resolved by reader section certification.

interactions.limitation: Bounded section accuracy can coexist with red commands. Eighteen reader reports are not an observed deciding-revision 64/64 bind.
retained_outputs: Read17 classified=0/9 without explicit fleet root; classified=9/9 with it
interactions.contradiction: A collective all-green or no-harm-restored claim would contradict the retained outputs; individual reader recommendations do not make such a claim.

interactions.limitation: Structural successor repair, historical completion, status_at_base, panel provenance and final execution remain separate claims.
interactions.contradiction: Post-BASE implementation does not rewrite a blind BASE verdict; current drift does not disprove historical completion. Older critic panel-absence prose cannot be asserted as current when the contract describes committed/staged panel state.

interactions.limitation: Lane errata do not repair original fleet-report bytes; gap-minor recommendations do not erase citation or clone-guidance debt.

risks: Do not treat the limitation table as a new admission mechanism.
Target patches could invalidate bind/freeze identities; this proposal changes no target.
Live fleet substrate observations are not a hermetic sibling snapshot at C0b.

verification.performed: Source/report reads and grep inventory over all eighteen reader markdown reports; selected exact attacker, critic, contract, counter and retained-monitor ranges read. No runtime checks.
missing_for_stronger_claims: Revision-bound C1 panel/re-seat/result provenance and applicable counter preconditions
C2 exact-element compliance tied to actual counter identity
Final committed bind measured at existing 64/64 floor and remaining contract monitors

mutations: Only own absolute d4 markdown and JSON reports written; no production changes, commits, delegation, installs or external requests.

self_evaluation.limitation: Documentary inventory and selected evidence inspected; retained executions not authenticated or re-executed.
